case_id.description: Stable ID, e.g. RWB-16, DF-01, ES-01, FO-04, AS-03, NR-01, REG-NULL-01

source.description: Path to the benchmark file this case is drawn from (cases are reused, not duplicated).

prompt.description: The user input given to the skill.

requested_depth.description: The depth the USER requested (independent of case complexity).

case_complexity.description: Objective count of power relations / mechanisms / positions — a case property, NOT a depth signal.

gold_ref.description: Path to the gold annotation for this case (calibration/gold/*.json).
